resources.string: Couldn\'t open the catalog. Check the network and try again.
No files yet. What this or another device sends shows up here.
The content stays in storage. This device does not download it.
Brings the file once and does not follow later changes.
Downloads, uploads and follows. A new file in this folder takes this state too.
The desktop shows the QR. The recovery password is not part of the invite.
Scan the QR shown on the desktop, or enter the invite.
Couldn\'t join. Check the code and that the other device still shows the invite.
Point the camera at the QR on the desktop.
Choose a folder. What you put in it goes to the repository. What comes from other devices shows up in the catalog and goes into the folder when you mark it to download.
The current folder stays as it is. The new one gets the files this device syncs.
Tap to sync now. The app also syncs when it opens.
The folder sync failed. Check the network and try again.
The folder did not answer or was suddenly empty. Nothing was deleted. Check the folder or choose it again.
Android no longer lets the app open this folder. Choose it again.
files edited during the sync go in the next one
This device keeps the recovery password and the maintenance credential. The other device joins with a code and does not type the account again.
The folder stays only on this device. It has no object versioning.

The storage needs versioning turned on and no lifecycle rule that deletes objects. The device key is limited to deleting its own locks only if the storage applies a policy per key (AWS S3, MinIO, RustFS). On R2 and B2 that key can delete everything.
Couldn\'t create. Check the fields, versioning and lifecycle rules.
The storage refused: turn on bucket versioning and remove lifecycle rules that delete objects.
The storage did not let this key check versioning. Give it admin permission on the bucket. R2 does not expose versioning through the S3 API and will always be refused.
A repository already exists here. Choose another prefix, or join it with a code.
Couldn\'t reach the storage. Check the endpoint, region and keys.
Check the fields. The device key must be different from the maintenance key.
The repository was created, but this device couldn\'t keep the grant in the vault. Keep the password below now: without it and without the grant, it can\'t be opened here again.
Keep this password in a password manager that opens without this repository. It shows only now, and the official restic uses this password.
Only this device, which created the repository, can change it.

Makes a new password and shows it once. The other devices keep opening with their own key. Anyone who kept the old key file, or reads old versions in a bucket with versioning, still opens with the old password: the data key does not change.
Couldn\'t change it. The old password still works. Check the connection to the storage.
The old password no longer opens the repository. Keep this one in the password manager.
Waiting for the other device to type the code.
The recovery password is not in the invite.
Couldn\'t approve. Close the invite and open it again.
